content.short: Frakt is a DeFi x NFT protocol that makes NFTs liquid by using them for collateral on loans.
content.description: Frakt enables NFT owners to unlock liquidity by pledging their NFTs or pool tokens as collateral for loans. Borrowers can access SOL and USDC liquidity against their assets, with options for perpetual loans featuring dynamic interest or flip loans with a fixed rate for a short term. Peer-to-pool lending lets users earn interest on SOL that can be exchanged for USDC. The Initial Liquidity Offering (ILO) approach helps maintain post-mint liquidity to reduce rug risk.
